solution:
The correct answer is __**B**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pampas **__is the __**grassland **__of __**South America**__.

 __
 
• As per **UNESCO**, land covered with herbaceous plants with** less than 10% tree and shrub cover**, is termed Grasslands.
 
• The vegetation in grasslands is primarily dominated by **herbs and grass**.
 
• They are **transitional landscapes** between **desert and forest **ecosystems.
